# Pega Cloud ACV Grows 20% in Q3 2026


- Cloud adoption continues to expand as Pega Cloud reaches 59% of total ACV in Q3
- Total ACV grows 6% as reported and 7% in constant currency year over year
- Company takes actions to accelerate growth and capitalize on AI market opportunity


**WALTHAM, Mass. — October 20, 2026 —** Pegasystems Inc. (NASDAQ: PEGA), the enterprise AI software company for mission-critical work, released its financial results for the third quarter of 2026.


"The AI market is still sorting itself out, but we’re confident in our long-term winning strategy to harness models like Claude, OpenAI GPT, and Gemini to help enterprises achieve predictable business outcomes at predictable costs while maintaining the governance, security, and control required for mission-critical operations,” said Alan Trefler, founder and CEO, Pega. "Our edge is decades of expertise in workflow automation and decisioning, enabling enterprises to scale AI with confidence, control, and economic efficiency.”


"While our ACV growth through the first three quarters of 2026 did not reflect the opportunity we see in the market, largely due to go-to-market execution challenges, our Q3 ACV add was the strongest of the year and reinforces our confidence in the demand for our solutions,” said Ken Stillwell, COO and CFO, Pega. “We are taking decisive actions to improve execution, accelerate growth, and keep us on track to deliver $700M or more of free cash flow in 2028.”


Purchasing behaviors continue to evolve as clients subject large technology investments to greater scrutiny as AI disrupts the industry. As a result, our ACV growth rate significantly slowed during the nine months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to the same period last year. These factors may continue to adversely affect the ACV growth rate for the rest of the year.


(1) Refer to the schedules at the end of this release for additional information, including a reconciliation of GAAP and non-GAAP measures.


As a result of the factors discussed under ACV above, our cash flow generation may continue to be adversely affected for the rest of the year.
